source_snapshot.criteria: An OTS brand or logo should appear during POST.

original_test_intent: Visually verify that the expected OTS brand/logo is rendered on the identified host's display during the POST window.
original_method: Bind host and display/console, approve one boot observation, start timestamped capture, observe the complete POST window, compare the visible logo to the approved reference, preserve original media, and confirm normal boot without changing BIOS settings.
manual_activity: Human observer must watch the correct pre-OS display, identify the OTS logo against a known-good reference and preserve readable photo/video evidence; automation may only archive and correlate the capture.
required_inputs: Physical monitor/camera or validated pre-OS video path
safety_requirements: Verify the display belongs to the target host
Do not clear logs for this observation
Reject OS splash or wrong-host image
Stop on unreadable/missing capture or boot failure
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Report observations without claiming human visual action or final verdict
engineer_actions: Own visual acceptance and final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states there is no ordinary SSH substitute for seeing the POST logo.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the human visual workflow using a physical display or validated BMC video capture; automation may preserve media and boot timestamps only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OTS logo, POST observation and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a timestamped continuous POST sequence tied to target identity and compare the clear logo frame to a controlled reference.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity, reference and recovery traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; remote video is evidence transport, not an OS-based substitution.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Timing, framing or wrong-host console selection can create false negatives or positives.

project_override_considerations: Project may approve physical or remote-console capture, but must supply the authoritative OTS artwork and preserve the same human visual judgment.
expected_evidence: Timestamped original POST photo/video showing logo
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require visual OTS-logo presence during POST.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The visual purpose is clear; observer, reference, capture path and reboot approval are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Turns a generic visual observation into target-bound, reference-backed and timestamped evidence with reboot recovery controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: The acceptance fact is a transient rendered brand image whose identity and correctness require human sight and comparison. A camera or remote KVM can capture it, but cannot remove the visual acceptance core, so MANUAL ONLY remains correct.
